text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Goodbye last year, hello new year!
So that's why I came to say hi!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Happy New Year.
I look forward to working with... with you again this year.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help it! My mom told me,
"Make sure you start the New Year properly!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I can't stand ceremonies that are just for show, but this one's got real substance. Besides, you're taking care of me this year too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So, as for my resolution for this year,
well, it goes without saying.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"To become the absolute coolest!"
This is it! It has to be this!
choice_data_list: By the way, what was your resolution last year?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be cool!
choice_data_list: What about the year before last?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I wanna be cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's not the same! It gets upgraded a little bit every single year!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, besides, we have the huge goal of the Derby this year, too.
choice_data_list: Should we make that our goal?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, true that!
Since we're here, might as well do that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Dream big—conquer the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So during New Year's, I'd like to do
some light work aiming toward that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You know, there's that sort of thing, right?
Superstitions for good luck, like "praying for victory."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Think up something that suits me. And then let's spend New Year's doing that.

A New Year's celebration that feels like Vodka, huh...
What kind of thing would be good?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Lucky maiden...? Doesn't being a 'happy girl'
feel totally out of character for me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm, wait a second? Come to think of it, some shrine
holds an event like that every year. Alright!

And so, Vodka entered a good-luck race
held at a certain shrine. The result was—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO, hell yeah!!
I'm this year's lucky maiden, babyyyy!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna barrel right through this year at this pace!
Let's goooo!

text_block_list.name: Worshippers
text_block_list.text: Lucky Girl! Lucky Girl!

Cheers celebrating Vodka's victory ring out.
Right from the start of the new year, her speed seems to have increased!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Two wheels?
I don't even have a bike, man.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
However, if you're still determined to ride it no matter what
...Alright!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this motorcycle game is sick!
Actually riding on the machine gets you so hyped, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, let's go all out gaming over New Year's,
Trainer! Maybe we'll keep the training light.

Spent New Year's playing our hearts out at the arcade.
It seemed to be a nice, refreshing break.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
An engine? Wait, an ape-man...? That's not
a motorcycle, that's just a monkey, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And what do you even do for a "Full Solution"?
Don't really get it, but let's give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Why did we come to the library of all places? And this book is... "Human Ancestor Trivia"~?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So I just gotta remember 'em all and guess right?
This one's Peking Man, and this guy's Java Man!
How's that?

"I spent the entire New Year studying all about early humans.
My knowledge expanded, broadening my perspective."
